snippet.title: Arizona Sunshine Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4308420/Arizona_Sunshine/

Arizona Sunshine is a flat-screen remake of the beloved VR zombie shooter. A new trailer aired during the Future Games Show at gamescom, showcasing split-screen co-operative gameplay from this sun-soaked apocalypse shooter, which is coming soon to PC.


https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
